name: Sampan
description: An 8 m open wooden Singapore/Malay sampan (bumboat-style) with a raised bow, painted eyes, floorboards and thwarts, an awning on four posts and a tiller outboard that steers and tilts.

param_docs.loa_m: Length overall including the outboard, metres (5-14). The hull itself is 0.67 m shorter.
param_docs.draught_m: Draught, metres: the outboard skeg reaches exactly this; the hull keel sits 2 cm above it.
param_docs.depth_m: Keel to gunwale amidships, metres. Freeboard amidships = depth - draught.
param_docs.bow_rise_m: How far the gunwale rises at the bow above the midships gunwale, metres (the raised sampan bow).
param_docs.canopy: true = awning on four posts over the middle of the boat.
param_docs.canopy_aft_x_m: Aft end of the awning, metres from amidships (negative = aft).
param_docs.canopy_fwd_x_m: Forward end of the awning, metres from amidships.
param_docs.canopy_height_m: Height of the awning edge above the floorboards, metres.
param_docs.oars: true = a pair of oars lying on the thwarts.
param_docs.eyes: true = painted eyes (oculus) on both sides of the bow.
param_docs.hull_color: Hull paint above the waterline, RGB 0-1.
param_docs.wood_color: Bare timber (floorboards, thwarts, foredeck, posts, oars), RGB 0-1.

meta.name: Sampan (8 m open outboard boat, Singapore)
meta.notes: StraitsSim has no sampan/bumboat type and no outboard propulsion: type 'fishing' is the closest small-craft type (StraitsSim's own sampan is fishing_7), and 'azimuth' is the closest propulsion because a tiller outboard steers by turning its thrust. Proportions follow StraitsSim's 7.2 m x 2.0 m x 0.38 m sampan and SEAFDEC 6-7 m outboard boats.
